steps: Volume conservation gives the radius of the bigger drop: (4/3)πR³ = 64 × (4/3)πr³, so R = 4r.
Charge conservation gives the total charge of the bigger drop: Q = 64q.
Surface charge density of a smaller drop is σ₁ = q / (4πr²).
Surface charge density of the bigger drop is σ₂ = Q / (4πR²) = 64q / (4π(4r)²) = 64q / (16 × 4πr²).
The ratio of the surface density of the bigger drop to the smaller drop is σ₂ : σ₁ = 4 : 1.
